rationale: The description says the software analyzes procurement/spending data and produces recommendations about savings, risk exposure and efficiency gaps. Those recommendations might come from conventional analytics or AI; no AI mechanism is stated, so non-AI is the best-supported forced choice, with uncertainty retained.
evidence_spans: It can provide recommendations for cost savings, risk exposure, and other efficiency gaps.
The software serves as an alternative to compiling data in an app such as Excel or Tableau and having a team of analysts comb through the information themselves.
